title: Twirling At The Altar
author: Steve Zakon-Anderson
problems: Row 7 "larks start a half hey - rights in center, lefts on ends with next neighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 8 "partners balance & swing, face the ones across (with whom you heyed) · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
Row 5 "robins start a left diagonal hey - rights in center, lefts on ends - until larks meet +" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
The progression after row 6 "partners allemande left ½ til larks face across" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
